notes.repository_relation: Do not copy a head intervention or confidence heuristic into this host. Require stale-answer-specific tests and preserve negative results instead of broad mechanism claims.

notes.method: One-layer faithful-copy surrogate with fixed content keys, distinct values and RoPE positional score. Pairwise log odds=(score_current−score_old)/T. Eq8 B(delta)=(2/T)sum_b w_b*abs(sin(delta*theta_b/2)).
notes.evidence_and_ablation: Holding existing scores fixed, adding a finite old candidate strictly reduces current/all-old odds. Unrelated candidates leave pairwise odds unchanged. Free energy=max/logsumexp bounded by max and max+Tlog(group size); fixed score-margin with growing old-count drives conditional current probability down.
notes.limitations: Not a full multi-layer LLM theorem. Single-band translation reversal needs nonconstant angle; multiband zero Cesaro mean rules out uniformly positive margin across all placements, not universal finite-context reversal. Delta can grow with count. Human memory analogy conceptual.
notes.repository_relation: Supports explicit current-state representation and limits on accumulated obsolete advice; does not authorize deleting history, approximate dependency closure or mechanically compressing text.

notes.method: Grammar-specific parser identifies latest explicit user update; assistant mentions and still-thinking/compare-options reminders excluded. Parser could answer directly. Selected query heads at final prompt position receive ±beta before softmax; adaptive beta=min(8,max(0,(m−delta)/2)).
